title: ISO Grade Oils - Viscosities and Densities
description: Viscosities and densities of ISO and equivalent SAE grade oils.

components.content:
## Overview

This tool provides reference data for ISO grade oils, including their viscosities and densities.

### ISO Grade Oil Classifications

ISO viscosity grades are standardized industrial oil classifications based on kinematic viscosity at 40°C:

| ISO Grade | Kinematic Viscosity (cSt at 40°C) | Typical SAE Equivalent | Typical Density (kg/m³) |
|-----------|--------------------------------------|------------------------|-------------------------|
| ISO 10 | 9-11 | SAE 5W | 800-820 |
| ISO 15 | 13.5-16.5 | SAE 10W | 810-830 |
| ISO 22 | 19.8-24.2 | SAE 15W | 815-835 |
| ISO 32 | 28.8-35.2 | SAE 20W | 820-840 |
| ISO 46 | 41.4-50.6 | SAE 30 | 825-845 |
| ISO 68 | 61.2-74.8 | SAE 40 | 830-850 |
| ISO 100 | 90-110 | SAE 50 | 835-855 |
| ISO 150 | 135-165 | SAE 60 | 840-860 |
| ISO 220 | 198-242 | - | 845-865 |
| ISO 320 | 288-352 | - | 850-870 |
| ISO 460 | 414-506 | - | 855-875 |
| ISO 680 | 612-748 | - | 860-880 |
| ISO 1000 | 900-1100 | - | 865-885 |

### Key Properties

- **Kinematic Viscosity**: Measured at 40°C (104°F), expressed in centistokes (cSt)
- **Density**: Typical range at 15°C, expressed in kg/m³
- **SAE Equivalents**: Approximate Society of Automotive Engineers classifications for motor oils

### Applications

- **ISO 10-32**: Light machine oils, refrigeration oils, spindle oils
- **ISO 46**: General purpose hydraulic oils, compressor oils
- **ISO 68-100**: Heavy-duty hydraulic oils, gear oils
- **ISO 150+**: Industrial gear oils, marine applications

### Notes

- Viscosity changes with temperature; these values are standardized at 40°C
- Actual densities vary by oil type and additives
- Always consult manufacturer specifications for specific applications
- Viscosity index affects how much viscosity changes with temperature
